talk.name: v00
talk.text: ……小燐。今天大学那边怎么样？

talk.name: v01
talk.text: 啊，兰，你回来啦！PAREO 呢？

talk.name: v02
talk.text: 啊，纱夜同学、友希那同学……欢迎回来

talk.name: v03
talk.text: 那时候的小燐，真可靠啊～！

talk.name: v04
talk.text: 嗯！但是今天亚子也不会输的！

talk.name: v05
talk.text: 嗯！发生了超好的事！

talk.name: v06
talk.text: 诶……？啊，嗯，很喜欢啊！

talk.name: v07
talk.text: 诶！？怎么突然这么说啊，晴海小姐？

talk.name: v08
talk.text: 和姐姐说话的时候，你紧张了吗……？

talk.name: v09
talk.text: 对……对不起！其实……

talk.name: v10
talk.text: 是呀，小燐！超级期待呢～！

talk.name: v11
talk.text: 这样啊！那对我们来说应该很轻松！

talk.name: v12
talk.text: 那难道不是叫温柔吗？

talk.name: v13
talk.text: 不过，这个真的超级费劲

talk.name: v14
talk.text: 但很少看见帅气的洋装~

talk.name: v15
talk.text: 哼哼~哼♪……啊，对了！

talk.name: v16
talk.text: 燐燐……你好帅……！

talk.name: v17
talk.text: 六花和真白，你们俩都太激动了啦~

talk.name: v18
talk.text: 哇，店长！谢谢你！

talk.name: v19
talk.text: 嗯～，可是人家好困嘛～

talk.name: v20
talk.text: 要对莉莎姐保密哦，但一定是这样！

talk.name: v21
talk.text: 冷吗！？那你干嘛穿那么薄！？

talk.name: v22
talk.text: 昨天听到的歌让我们很在意！

talk_short.name: v22
talk_short.text: 昨天听到的歌让我们很在意！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v00
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: ……小燐。今天大学那边怎么样？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v01
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊，兰，你回来啦！PAREO 呢？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v02
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊，纱夜同学、友希那同学……欢迎回来

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v03
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 那时候的小燐，真可靠啊～！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v04
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 嗯！但是今天亚子也不会输的！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v05
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 嗯！发生了超好的事！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v06
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 诶……？啊，嗯，很喜欢啊！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v07
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 诶！？怎么突然这么说啊，晴海小姐？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v08
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 和姐姐说话的时候，你紧张了吗……？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v09
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 对……对不起！其实……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v10
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 是呀，小燐！超级期待呢～！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v11
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 这样啊！那对我们来说应该很轻松！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v12
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 那难道不是叫温柔吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v13
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 不过，这个真的超级费劲

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v14
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 但很少看见帅气的洋装~

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v15
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 哼哼~哼♪……啊，对了！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v16
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 燐燐……你好帅……！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v17
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 六花和真白，你们俩都太激动了啦~

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v18
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 哇，店长！谢谢你！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v19
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 嗯～，可是人家好困嘛～

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v20
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 要对莉莎姐保密哦，但一定是这样！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v21
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 冷吗！？那你干嘛穿那么薄！？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v22
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 昨天听到的歌让我们很在意！
